filter_rules.primary_events: bucket_distribution events with pass K* selection
filter_rules.bar_construction: 1h uses raw Deribit 60-minute OHLC; Nh aggregates fresh traded 60-minute rows and uses the last traded close inside the block.
filter_rules.fresh_option_row: has_real_trade and close > 0 within the Deribit 60-minute OHLC candle
filter_rules.spot_anchor: median same-hour put-call parity spot from traded call/put pairs
filter_rules.survival_estimator: local call-spread digital using nearest traded call strikes strictly below and above K*
filter_rules.timestamp_alignment: Deribit and Polymarket hourly panels are aligned on floored hour-bucket labels; close/last sampled values are interpreted as within-hour endpoints.

known_caveats: Deribit TradingView 60-minute OHLC does not expose exact last-trade timestamps inside the candle.
The local call-spread digital is a first-pass estimator; it is sensitive to sparse hourly call strikes around K*.
Bars without same-hour parity pairs or bracketing fresh call strikes fail explicitly and must not enter lead-lag tests.
